finalText:
Migration's done. Every `db.query` call in the app code now uses `db.execute({ sql, params })` — 11 files across accounts, orders, billing, catalog, support, and analytics.

One spot still uses the old call: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. Its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and not to be edited — so I left it alone. Worth checking whether `db` still needs to support the old `query` method for that shim.
